To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
The recA gene is 3.5 kb in length and located 5.7 kb away from the negative regulatory gene, srlR.

(1) the srlR gene is located at a distance of 5.8 kbp from the promoter proximal end of the structural recA gene, and that (2) the recA structural locus is deleted for 40, 45, 50 and 100%, respectively, in the mutants, del(srlrecA)302, 304, 303 and 306.

the Tn10 generated deletion del(srl-recAA)306, which removes the entire recA gene, has been found to have a 2.3-fold increase in sensitivity to ultraviolet light, a 1.8-fold increase in sensitivity of DNA repair, and a 1.6-fold increase in sensitivity for induction of the RecF pathway of DNA repair.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the physical and genetic mapping of the surl recA region of E. coli.
the construction and analysis of physical maps of DNA regions of interest to us, and the characterization of mutations that we have generated by Tn10 insertion.
the construction and characterization of a series of deletions in the srl-recA region of E. coli.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the srl-recA region of E. coli is 23.5 kb long and that the Tn10 insertions and deletional mutations in the srl-recApromoter region have not altered the structure of the recA promoter region.
the recA gene in Escherichia coil is 50.4 kb away from srlR301, the promoter roximally located regulatory gene of the srl operon.
Tn10 generated insertion or deletion mutations can be used for physical mapping of DNA sequences.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the srlR and srlA genes are located 5.3 kb apart, and are separated from the recA gene by a 2.2 kb segment of the E. coli chromosome; that the srlR gene is 2.2-2.5 kb in length; that the srrA gene is 0.9 kb in length; and that the recA gene is 3.5 kb in size.
the Tn10 insertion in srlR has been shown to be 5.8 kilobase pairs upstream of the promoter proximal end of the structural recA gene.
the srl rec A region is 23.5 kb long and that the srlR and recA genes are separated by approximately 6 kb.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the recA gene in E. coli is located in a region that is rich in insertion sequences.
the recA gene in Escherichia coil is not essential and can be deleted.
the Tn10 insertion srlR301 is an efficient target for generating deletions that remove the recA structural region.
